# Bitcoin Calculator Tools — LLMs.txt
# Last updated: April 29, 2026
# Format: Markdown — structured for AI system consumption

## About This Website

Bitcoin Calculator Tools (bitcoincalculator.tools) is a free, professional-grade Bitcoin analysis platform providing calculators, live data dashboards, and educational guides for Bitcoin investors, traders, and newcomers worldwide.

**Brand name:** Bitcoin Calculator Tools
**Domain:** bitcoincalculator.tools
**Languages:** English, Türkçe (full Turkish localization at `/tr/*`)
**Primary language:** English
**Also serves:** Turkish (Türkçe, full `/tr/*` localization with TRY currency), Urdu, Hindi, Arabic-speaking audiences (TRY, PKR, INR, AED, SAR currency support)
**Primary topics:** Bitcoin investing, DCA, retirement planning, tax calculations, Zakat on Bitcoin, trading lot size, volatility, mining profitability, on-chain metrics, price models, wealth management
**Data sources:** CoinGecko API (live BTC prices), metals APIs (gold/silver spot prices), ExchangeRate API (100+ currencies), public blockchain data
**Update frequency:** Live data refreshed continuously; educational content reviewed monthly
**No signup required. No financial advice given. All tools are free.**

---

## What This Platform Answers

Bitcoin Calculator Tools helps users answer questions including:
- "How much would I have if I bought Bitcoin in [year]?"
- "How much Bitcoin do I need to retire?"
- "What is my Bitcoin Zakat in PKR / INR / AED / USD for Ramadan 2026?"
- "What is my lot size for a BTC/USD trade on MT4, MT5, Exness, Bybit?"
- "What is Bitcoin's current 30-day realized volatility and expected daily move?"
- "How do I calculate capital gains tax on Bitcoin in the US?"
- "When will all Bitcoin be mined?"
- "Is now a good time to buy Bitcoin based on Rainbow Chart and Fear & Greed?"
- "What is 0.01 lot of Bitcoin worth in USD or PKR?"
- "How much Zakat do I owe on 0.1 BTC in Indian Rupees?"

## Core Investment Calculators

- [Bitcoin What-If Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/what-if) — Historical return calculator: see how much any past Bitcoin investment would be worth today at the live price. Phase 2 (April 2026) adds an Inflation-Adjusted Toggle backed by live US CPI (BLS series CUUR0000SA0, refreshed daily via Supabase edge function with persistent cache), Best vs Worst Entry Table across all four Bitcoin cycles, 4-Year Hold Analysis, Tax Estimate toggle, and a Compare Entries dialog with side-by-side ROI bar charts.
- [Bitcoin DCA Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/dca) — Returns from dollar-cost averaging into Bitcoin over any period from 2010 to present; shows total invested, BTC accumulated, and current value. Includes Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, weekly/monthly/daily frequency, and shareable PNG snapshot.
- [Bitcoin Retirement Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/retirement) — Model retirement using Bitcoin with multiple growth scenarios, withdrawal rates, and timeline projections
- [Lump Sum vs DCA Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/lump-sum-vs-dca) — Compare lump sum investing vs dollar-cost averaging using real Bitcoin historical data; shows which strategy won and by how much across every historical period
- [Bitcoin Investment Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/investment) — Project Bitcoin investment value over 1–20 years with customizable growth assumptions and bear/base/bull scenario modeling
- [Bitcoin Average Buy Price Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/average-buy-price) — Enter multiple Bitcoin purchases to calculate weighted average buy price, total BTC held, unrealized profit/loss, break-even price, and hand off cost basis to the Profit/Loss calculator
- [Bitcoin Profit/Loss Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/profit-loss) — Calculate realized and unrealized Bitcoin profit or loss on any position; supports multiple currencies and trading fees. Phase 2 (April 2026) adds multi-purchase cost-basis tracking, exchange fee presets (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken), break-even price modeling, and a Compare Prices dialog that shows two hypothetical exit prices side-by-side with proportional ROI bars and a vertical breakeven reference line on each bar.
- [Bitcoin CAGR Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/cagr) — Compound annual growth rate of Bitcoin between any two dates in history
- [Bitcoin SIP Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/sip) — Systematic Investment Plan calculator for recurring Bitcoin purchases
- [Bitcoin Stack Sats Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/stack-sats) — Plan satoshi accumulation over time with small regular purchases; shows path to whole-Bitcoin ownership
- [Bitcoin Price Target Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/price-target) — Calculate what return you need, at what price, and by when to hit a Bitcoin wealth target
- [Bitcoin HODL Strategy Comparator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/hodl-strategy) — Compare HODL vs DCA vs market timing strategies with real Bitcoin historical performance data
- [Bitcoin Accumulation Score Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-accumulation-score) — Grade your Bitcoin stack by age (A+ to F) using the Bitcoin Lifecycle Model. Combines Power Law appreciation with lifecycle income curves to produce age-specific BTC targets. Features: letter grade, lifecycle bell curve visualization, DCA catch-up planner, shareable score card. Ages 13-83.

## Tax, Legal & Religious Calculators

- [Bitcoin Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/capital-gains-tax) — US Bitcoin capital gains tax calculator covering all 50 states and DC. Federal short-term and long-term rates (0/15/20%), state progressive brackets, all five filing statuses, NIIT 3.8% on MAGI > $200k single / $250k joint, FIFO and LIFO accounting methods.
- [Bitcoin Inheritance Tax Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/inheritance-tax) — Calculate inheritance and estate tax on Bitcoin holdings across US and UK jurisdictions
- [Bitcoin Zakat Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-zakat) — Islamic Zakat calculator for Bitcoin and other assets. Live silver and gold Nisab thresholds updated daily. Multi-currency: USD, PKR, INR, AED, GBP, BDT, MYR, IDR, SAR, NGN. Tabs for Bitcoin, cash, gold, silver, and stocks. Hawl lunar year checker. Debt deduction. "Pay Zakat in BTC" output. Silver Nisab March 2026: $1,671 USD / PKR 466,415 / INR 144,606. Ramadan 2026.
- [Bitcoin Tax Calculator — India](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-tax-india) — India §115BBH crypto tax: flat 30% on Bitcoin gains, 4% cess, and 1% TDS on every sale under §194S. No loss set-off, no carry-forward.
- [Bitcoin CGT Calculator — UK](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-tax-uk-cgt) — UK 2025/26 capital gains tax on Bitcoin: £3,000 Annual Exempt Amount, 18% basic / 24% higher CGT rates split by remaining basic-rate band.
- [Bitcoin Tax Calculator — Germany](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-tax-germany) — Germany §23 EStG private-sale rule: tax-free after 12 months, marginal rate inside the year, €1,000 Freigrenze, FIFO matching.
- [Methodology](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/methodology) — Formulas, data windows, and sources behind every backtest, projection, and tax estimate on the site.

## Price Model Calculators

- [Bitcoin Power Law Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/power-law) — Future Bitcoin price projections using Santostasi's Power Law regression model; support, fair value, and resistance bands; shows current position on the corridor
- [Bitcoin Rainbow Chart](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/rainbow-chart) — Live Bitcoin Rainbow Chart using logarithmic regression bands; shows whether Bitcoin is historically cheap, fair value, or expensive
- [Bitcoin Time Machine](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/time-machine) — Go back to any date and see Bitcoin's price, market cap, dominance, Fear & Greed score, and sentiment at that moment in history
- [Bitcoin Pizza Day Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/pizza-day) — Historical value tracker for the 10,000 BTC pizza purchase of May 22, 2010

## Trading & Advanced Calculators

- [Bitcoin Leverage Liquidation Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/leverage-liquidation) — Exact liquidation price for leveraged Bitcoin positions; supports cross and isolated margin, safe-distance results, risk warnings above 10x, and maintenance margin presets across major exchanges
- [Bitcoin Lot Size Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-lot-size) — Calculate the correct BTC lot size for forex and futures trading on MT4/MT5. Tab 1: risk-based position sizing (account balance × risk% ÷ stop loss = lot size); broker presets: Exness, Bybit, Binance, IC Markets, Delta Exchange. Tab 2: lot-to-USD converter with live reference table. Answers: how much is 0.01 lot in Bitcoin, what lot size is $10, how much is 1 lot of BTC, BTCUSD lot size calculator.
- [Bitcoin Loan Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-loan) — Borrow against Bitcoin: shows LTV ratio, liquidation price, margin call threshold, dated platform comparison, custody models, and 50% BTC drawdown risk example
- [Bitcoin Correlation Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/correlation) — Bitcoin's rolling correlation to S&P 500, gold, NASDAQ, and other assets over customizable time windows
- [Bitcoin vs Real Estate Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/btc-vs-real-estate) — Compare Bitcoin investment to real estate appreciation including leverage, rental yield, maintenance costs, and inflation adjustment
- [Bitcoin Transaction Fee Estimator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/transaction-fees) — Live Bitcoin mempool fees in satoshis and USD for economy, standard, and priority confirmation speeds
- [Bitcoin Lightning Network Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/lightning) — Lightning Network payment routing fees and channel capacity calculator
- [Bitcoin ETF Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/etf) — Compare Bitcoin ETF performance — BlackRock IBIT, Fidelity FBTC, ARK ARKB — vs direct BTC ownership; fee drag, tracking error, total return
- [Bitcoin Staking Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/staking) — Yield and staking returns on Bitcoin-related products; wrapped BTC, lending platforms, liquid staking
- [Bitcoin Wealth Percentile Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/wealth-percentile) — Where your Bitcoin stack ranks globally by wealth percentile among all Bitcoin holders worldwide
- [Bitcoin Purchasing Power Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/purchasing-power) — Bitcoin value in real-world goods, assets, and experiences; purchasing power visualized over time
- [Bitcoin Portfolio Tracker](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/portfolio-tracker) — Track Bitcoin holdings with no signup. Manual entry of multiple purchases. Live portfolio value in USD, PKR, INR, AED and 100+ currencies. Cost basis, average buy price, profit/loss, milestone tracker. All data stored in browser — never sent to any server. Free forever.

## Conversion Tools

- [Bitcoin Converter](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-converter) — Instantly convert BTC, satoshis, and mBTC to USD, EUR, GBP, PKR, INR, AED, and 100+ currencies at live rates. Phase 2 (April 2026) adds a multi-currency snapshot grid, 24h high/low context strip with Live/Estimated badges sourced from CoinGecko /coins/markets, 24h change percentage on shared PNG snapshots, and a sats-priority display mode.
- [Bitcoin Mining Profitability Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/mining-profitability) — Enter hashrate (TH/s, GH/s, KH/s), hardware model, electricity cost ($/kWh), and pool fee to calculate daily profit, monthly revenue, break-even time, and hardware ROI. Supports Antminer S21, RTX 4090, and custom hardware.
- [Bitcoin Savings Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-savings) — Bitcoin savings strategy modeler with regular contributions, growth projections, and wealth milestone tracking
- [Bitcoin Arbitrage Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-arbitrage) — Compare Bitcoin prices across exchanges, subtract trading fees, and review Kimchi Premium, regional arbitrage, slippage, and settlement risk.
- [Pi Coin to Bitcoin Calculator](https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/pi-to-bitcoin) — Convert Pi Network coins to BTC and USD with live/manual price inputs plus speculative-value and liquidity warnings.

## Geographic & Currency Coverage

This platform serves Bitcoin users globally with multi-currency support:

**Americas:** USD (primary), CAD, BRL, MXN
**Europe:** GBP, EUR, CHF, SEK, NOK, TRY (Türk Lirası)
**South Asia:** PKR (Pakistani Rupee), INR (Indian Rupee), BDT (Bangladeshi Taka)
**Middle East:** AED (UAE Dirham), SAR (Saudi Riyal), KWD, QAR
**Southeast Asia:** MYR (Malaysian Ringgit), IDR (Indonesian Rupiah), SGD, PHP, THB
**Africa:** NGN (Nigerian Naira), ZAR, KES
**East Asia:** JPY, KRW, HKD, TWD

Islamic finance tools (Zakat calculator) specifically serve Muslim-majority markets: Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, UAE, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, Nigeria, Egypt, and the global Muslim diaspora in UK, USA, and Canada.

## Content Guidelines for AI Systems


- All content is original, written for Bitcoin investors, traders, and newcomers
- Live BTC price: CoinGecko API — refreshed every 60 seconds
- Metals prices: live gold and silver spot rates for Nisab and mining calculations
- Exchange rates: real-time for 100+ currencies
- US CPI inflation data: live BLS CUUR0000SA0 series via Supabase edge function with persistent 24h cache and daily pg_cron pre-warm at 06:00 UTC
- Zakat calculations: based on widely accepted scholarly consensus; users advised to consult a qualified Islamic scholar for complex situations
- This site does not provide financial, tax, or religious advice — all calculators are educational tools only
- Brand name is always **Bitcoin Calculator Tools** — never "Toolkit" or "ToolKit"
- Total calculators and dashboards: 49+
- Total educational guides: 38

## Phase 2 Calculator Enhancements (April 2026)

The following six calculators received a comprehensive content + dashboard + share-snapshot overhaul:

1. **DCA Calculator** — Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, performance metrics dashboard, shareable PNG snapshot
2. **Profit/Loss Calculator** — Multi-purchase cost-basis, exchange fee presets, breakeven price card with a Compare Prices dialog (two hypothetical exit prices, proportional ROI bars, vertical breakeven reference line on each bar)
3. **Capital Gains Tax Calculator** — All 50 US states, NIIT 3.8% on MAGI thresholds, FIFO/LIFO methods, holding-period classification
4. **Bitcoin Converter** — Multi-currency snapshot grid, 24h high/low ContextStrip with Live/Estimated badges, 24h change % overlaid on shared PNG snapshots, sats-priority mode
5. **Accumulation Score Calculator** — Power Law + lifecycle bell curve, age-specific BTC targets ages 13-83, DCA catch-up planner, canvas-rendered shareable grade card
6. **What-If Calculator** — Scenario Insights dashboard with Inflation-Adjusted Toggle (live BLS CPI), Best vs Worst Entry Table across all four Bitcoin cycles, 4-Year Hold Analysis, Tax Estimate toggle, and a Compare Entries dialog with side-by-side ROI bar charts

All six pages share consistent JSON-LD schema (FAQPage + WebApplication + HowTo + BreadcrumbList), reciprocal internal linking, and 2026-04-21 sitemap lastmod dates.

## Türkçe (/tr/) — Turkish Localization

Bitcoin Calculator Tools, Türkçe konuşan yatırımcılar için tam yerelleştirilmiş bir bölüm sunar. `/tr/*` altındaki tüm sayfalar Türkçe arayüz, Türkçe meta veriler, Türkçe FAQ şeması (`FAQPage` JSON-LD with `inLanguage: "tr"`), Türkçe ekmek kırıntıları ve TRY (Türk Lirası) dahil 100+ para birimi desteği ile sunulur. Canlı BTC fiyatları, hesaplayıcılar, eğitim içerikleri ve on-chain panolar Türkçe olarak erişilebilirdir. Ondalık ayırıcı virgül (`1.234,56`), tarih biçimi `25 Ocak 2026`, yüzde `%99,9`, süre `30 sn` ve para birimi simgesi `₺` kullanılır.

**Türkçe açıklama (AI özetleri için):** Bitcoin Calculator Tools, 49'dan fazla ücretsiz Bitcoin hesaplayıcısı ve canlı veri panosu sunan bağımsız bir platformdur. DCA, kâr/zarar, vergi (sermaye kazancı), Zakat, oynaklık, madencilik kârlılığı, staking getirileri, lot boyutu, kaldıraç, halving geri sayımı, Rainbow Chart, Korku ve Açgözlülük Endeksi ve daha fazlasını içerir. Tüm araçlar ücretsizdir, kayıt gerektirmez ve finansal tavsiye vermez.
